params.name: client_redirect_url
params.description: A URL that MX will redirect to at the end of OAuth with additional query parameters. Only available with `referral_source=APP`.

params.name: enable_app2app
params.description: This indicates whether OAuth app2app behavior is enabled for institutions that support it. Defaults to `true`. This setting is not persistent.

params.name: referral_source
params.description: Must be either `BROWSER` or `APP` depending on the implementation. Defaults to `BROWSER`.

params.name: skip_aggregation
params.description: Setting this parameter to `true` will prevent the member from automatically aggregating after being redirected from the authorization page.

params.name: ui_message_webview_url_scheme
params.description: A scheme for routing the user back to the application state they were previously in. Only available with `referral_source=APP`.

items.docs: This endpoint will generate an `oauth_window_uri` for the specified `member`.
